comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Primarily a rural Alaska electric utility; telecom is secondary and the business mix differs from a fiber broadband provider.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mixes mobile wireless and international Caribbean operations with US broadband; a broader, different business than a regional fiber/cable provider.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Diversified holding company dominated by billboards and insurance; broadband is only a small part.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Alaska integrated carrier led by wireless, with cable and fiber; GCI's wireless-heavy mix and Alaska-only footprint differ.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: TDS Telecom sells fiber/cable broadband, video and voice to residential and business customers in smaller US markets, like Shentel.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Owns fiber networks selling consumer and business broadband plus wholesale fiber transport to carriers, matching Shentel's fiber and wholesale mix.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Satellite broadband and defense equipment maker; different technology, products and customers than terrestrial fiber broadband.
